claims: The 2026 MLB season officially begins on Wednesday, March 25.
Opening Night game is between the New York Yankees and San Francisco Giants at Oracle Park.
Opening Night game is streamed on Netflix.
Opening Night is Wednesday, March 25 at 8:05 p.m. ET.
Traditional Opening Day is Thursday, March 26.
World Champion Dodgers vs. Diamondbacks on March 26.
Diamondbacks (Zac Gallen) vs. Dodgers (Yoshinobu Yamamoto) on March 26.
Max Fried (Yankees) vs. Logan Webb (Giants) on March 25.
Paul Skenes (Pirates) vs. Freddy Peralta (Mets) on March 26.
The Mexico City Series returns on April 25-26 with the Diamondbacks and Padres.
PIT Pirates vs. NYM Mets at 1:15 p.m. ET on NBC/Peacock on March 26, 2026.
ARI Diamondbacks vs. LAD Dodgers at 5:30 p.m. PT on NBC on March 26, 2026.
DET Tigers vs. SD Padres on March 26, 2026.
LAA Angels vs. HOU Astros on March 26, 2026.
